definitions.explanation: A person with specialized technical knowledge and skills, working in fields such as engineering, IT, manufacturing, or applied sciences.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自動車|じどうしゃ}→自動車：02886_jidousha⟧⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}だ。
examples.english: My father is an engineer at an automobile company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優秀|ゆうしゅう}→優秀：03646_yuushuu⟧な{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しく→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It is becoming difficult to secure talented engineers.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧し、⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This bridge was designed by Japanese engineers and has attracted attention worldwide.

notes:
USAGE:
A broad term covering various types of technical professionals. Can refer to software engineers, mechanical engineers, civil engineers, and other specialists. In immigration contexts, {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ} is one of the visa categories for foreign workers in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- IT{技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ} (IT engineer)
- {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育成|いくせい}→育成：13928_ikusei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to train engineers)
- {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}{不足|ぶそく} (shortage of engineers)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦エンジニア→エンジニア：05059_enjinia⟧: engineer — loanword, often used in IT and software contexts
- ⟦{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}→研究者：02573_kenkyuusha⟧: researcher — focuses on research rather than applied work
